promotion_policy: STABLE contains confirmed builds. BETA remains separate and is used for testing before promotion.
architecture: 10.26 BETA = frozen 10.6 UI base + Nick Integrity + 10.22 ACK-aware Friends core + 10.23 bounded Queue Watch + 10.24 per-connection trace + 10.25 fresh per-connection 159 merge + 10.26 ACK-to-85 route diagnostics + clean Friends panel + confirmed 10.19 MIX 8/8 + Ice dark-text overlay. Honour Probe remains removed.

versions.label: 10.26 BETA — ACK ROUTE TRACE
versions.notes: Current beta. Diagnostic-only route correlation: records which socket delivers ACK 8/4 and which socket sends the following code 85, flagging ROUTE_MISMATCH when they differ. No timing or protocol behavior changes. Includes 10.25 merge and frozen MIX 10.19.

versions.label: 10.25 BETA — SNAPSHOT MERGE
versions.notes: Immediate rollback. Keeps ACK/85 timings unchanged and prevents fresh 159 from one socket from blindly erasing friends seen on another socket.

versions.label: 10.24 BETA — SNAPSHOT TRACE
versions.notes: Diagnostic rollback. Records each incoming 159 by connection/room and flags divergent snapshots without changing state arbitration.

versions.label: 10.23 BETA — QUEUE WATCH
versions.notes: Queue Watch rollback. Bounded one-at-a-time retries plus snapshot-drop diagnostics.

versions.label: 10.22 BETA — FRIEND ACK SYNC
versions.notes: ACK Sync rollback. send 8/4, wait for server 8/4 ACK, then 85 and 159 rooms[].

versions.label: 10.20 BETA — FRIEND IDENTITY GUARD
versions.notes: Identity-guard rollback. Canonical nick and context-menu experiments; no Honour Probe.

versions.label: 10.19 BETA — COLOR-ALIGNED MIX
versions.notes: User-confirmed working MIX 8/8 build and writing rollback.

versions.label: 10.17 BETA — APK EXACT ROOMS
versions.notes: Frozen Friend Radar baseline previously confirmed working for server-returned friends.
